Text: Just hit 30K followers 🎉

I honestly can’t believe how fast this account grew considering I only started posting seriously less than six months ago.

I doubt there are many non-frontier lab accounts that have grown at this pace.

I genuinely love posting on X. It’s been a blast.

I’m only human, so I get things wrong sometimes, but I’m super grateful to everyone who keeps tuning in anyway.

Let’s keep going until open source wins.💪
